title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Partial Claim Reduction for a Disability Compensation Overpayment
content:
A VA partial claim on a VA Home Loan Guaranty loan is reduced where the veteran owes a Disability Compensation Overpayment, according to the state of that overpayment in the veteran's Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery records: whether it is in active collection or under a repayment plan, its current balance and its plan's monthly amount.

## Reduction for other debts

| Disability Compensation Overpayment in active collection | Disability Compensation Overpayment under a repayment plan | Reduction of the partial claim |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | That overpayment's balance |
| No | Yes | That plan's monthly amount |
| Yes | Yes | Not reduced for other debts |
| No | No | Not reduced for other debts |

Only a debt of the Disability Compensation Overpayment type is read; other debt types do not reduce the partial claim.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- An overpayment in active collection with a balance of 3,200.00 dollars and none under a plan: the partial claim is reduced by 3,200.00 dollars.
- An overpayment under a repayment plan of 125.00 dollars a month and none in active collection: the partial claim is reduced by 125.00 dollars.
- No Disability Compensation Overpayment: no reduction for other debts.
